business_summary: Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells organic silicon methylsilane and phenyl products. It offers hexamethyldisilazane, hexamethyldisiloxane, iodotrimethylsilane, dimethyldiethoxylsilane, trimethylchlorosilane, sodium hexamethyldisilazane, hexamethyldisilane, hexamethyldisilylurea, dimethyldimethoxysilane, trimethylethoxysilane, and hexamethyldisilylurea products. The company also provides phenyltrimethoxysilane, phenyltriethoxysilane, diphenyldimethoxysilane, diphenyldiethoxysilane, octaphenylcyclotetrasiloxane, and diphenyldihydroxysilane; and phenyl silicone rubber, phenyl silicone resin, and phenyl silicone oil. Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Suqian, China.
business_summary_ko: Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd는 유기 실리콘 메틸실란 및 페닐 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 헥사메틸디실라잔, 헥사메틸디실록산, 요오도트리메틸실란, 디메틸디에톡실실란, 트리메틸클로로실란, 나트륨 헥사메틸디실라잔, 헥사메틸디실란, 헥사메틸디실우레아, 디메틸디메톡시실란, 트리메틸에톡시실란 및 헥사메틸디실릴우레아 제품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 페닐트리메톡시실란, 페닐트리에톡시실란, 디페닐디메톡시실란, 디페닐디에톡시실란, 옥타페닐시클로테트라실록산 및 디페닐디히드록시실란을 제공합니다. 페닐 실리콘 고무, 페닐 실리콘 수지, 페닐 실리콘 오일 등을 들 수 있다. Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd는 1992년에 설립되었으며 중국 쑤첸(Suqian)에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
